purpose: Continue the runnable local workbench and repaired shared registration engine, preserving 3-D explorer and evidence history.
truth_invariants: Prediction is not observation.
Simulation output cannot mutate canonical geometry or promote evidence maturity.
UNVERIFIED geometry remains UNVERIFIED after simulation.
FORGE cells are ASSUMED analysis cells until evidence promotion replaces them.
Missing uncertainty is not zero.
Unknown physical parameters must remain unresolved rather than receiving convenient defaults.
Source discrepancies must be preserved, not averaged away.
Retracted methods have zero geometry-write authority unless independently revalidated.
Claims and evidence are separate registries.
Uncalibrated photographs cannot write metric geometry.
Open-media category counts overlap and must not be summed as unique assets.
Per-file license/attribution metadata must travel with every cached original.
EXIF/camera metadata are registration priors, not solved calibration.
Consumer photo GPS is context only and cannot become survey control.
Survey/geographic coordinates retain their source CRS and vertical datum until a transform receipt is issued.
A registration solve must preserve reprojection residuals and uncertainty before evidence promotion.
Survey-backed orientation is a prior and cannot by itself establish translation, elevation or geometry mutation.
Published survey-coordinate variants remain distinct until reconciled by an explicit adjustment receipt.
A projective 3x4 camera matrix is not a calibrated Euclidean camera pose.
Real registration jobs cannot become solved without actual marked pixel correspondences and stored residuals.
Confirmed source status does not imply geometry-write authority.
Institutional summaries, historical observations, curatorial attributions and expert archaeological interpretations remain distinct truth classes.
Unsupported extraordinary-technology claims remain visible with zero authority rather than being silently promoted or deleted.
Radiocarbon chronology retains sample-context and old-wood caveats.
A verified remote source is not equivalent to locally possessed source bytes.
Every cached primary artifact requires rights state and SHA-256; upstream checksums are retained when available.
ACCESS_RESTRICTED sources must never be fetched by bypassing access controls.
Normalized source snapshots are derived metadata, never raw source bytes.
Every parser-derived datum requires an input byte hash or remote-lock provenance, parser version and source locator before promotion.
Intent hypotheses are explanatory models, not recovered ancient testimony.
Historical meaning cannot be inferred from geometry alone.
Intent evidence must track source-family independence so one synthesis is not counted as several independent confirmations.
Intent scores are triage indices, not probabilities of historical truth.
Future-message, machine-function and advanced-computation hypotheses remain visible but cannot be strengthened by numerical coincidence alone.
An intent hypothesis cannot mutate canonical geometry or evidence maturity.
SCHEMATIC map coordinates are visual/topological only and cannot write metric geometry.
Metric map layers retain their native coordinate frame and unresolved transform state.
Ritual-route maps are evidence-linked interpretations, not recovered ancient testimony.
Photo coverage maps cannot georeference images without solved QA-passed camera registration.
A normalized observation with a source locator is not equivalent to raw primary-source byte custody.
SOURCE PARSER may preserve or reduce authority but may never increase geometry-write authority.
Every ACTION GRAPH action node requires at least one source-addressed parsed evidence record.
ACTION GRAPH edges are behavioral hypotheses or topological constraints, not recovered ancient ritual testimony.
Evidence-strength indices in ACTION GRAPH are triage values, not probabilities of historical truth.
Royal-image presence in the Valley Temple is direct archaeological/object provenance; exact ancient placement and choreography remain unresolved.
PRIMARY PLAN PARSER remote text/OCR is not source-byte custody or metric coordinate authority.
ROOM GRAPH coordinates are SCHEMATIC UI positions and cannot write canonical geometry.
ROOM GRAPH topology does not prove recovered ritual choreography; findspot does not prove original placement.
PLAN CONCORDANCE agreement classes are descriptive evidence convergence, not probability or metric registration.
Derivative plan reconstructions must not be counted as independent replication; preserve independence groups.
VISIBILITY LAB current outputs are pre-metric graph/topology metrics and contain zero metric sightline rays.
A graph articulation/chokepoint does not by itself establish ritual, social, or access restriction.
Schematic ROOM GRAPH coordinates may not be reused as metric wall/opening coordinates.
Detailed reconstruction conflicts remain explicit even when coarse architectural program converges across sources.
A remotely downloadable PDF, IIIF canvas, or archive record is not local source-byte custody.
SOURCE-BYTE REGISTRATION requires actual local bytes plus computed SHA-256 before raw_byte_verified may become true.
Rights/attribution gates must pass before source-byte acquisition or bundling.
A printed scale or scale bar is not a coordinate frame and does not authorize metric promotion by itself.
Every plan registration requires controls, independent holdouts, stored residuals, and a preregistered outlier/residual policy.
METRIC VIEW LAB contains zero metric sightline rays until registered wall/opening geometry and explicit height assumptions exist.
Historical descriptions of light/reflection are architectural reconstruction evidence, not photometric measurements or proof of psychological intent.
Plate-local metric registration and global plateau georeferencing are separate authorities.
Holdout coordinates and residual thresholds are frozen before the first archaeological plan fit.
Synthetic registration benchmarks validate algorithms only and never create archaeological geometry authority.
A failed external byte transfer leaves raw_byte_verified=false and must remain visible as an acquisition receipt.
A remote-rendered plan page is a witness, not checksum-bound source-byte custody.
Source-reported scalar dimensions may constrain measurements but may not be assembled into unique 2-D wall polygons without registered geometry.
Provider-displayed file metadata is a noncryptographic remote fingerprint and cannot substitute for local SHA-256.
A local source import grants byte custody only; geometry authority remains unchanged.
Every Plate VI pixel coordinate must bind both the local source PDF SHA-256 and the exact local render SHA-256.
Named landmark classes may be preregistered before pixels exist, but pixel/metric coordinates remain null until a checksum-bound local render is reviewed.
Holdout coordinates and landmark roles freeze before the first archaeological similarity fit.
Residual classifications are diagnostic candidates, not causal conclusions.
Every archaeological holdout residual is retained; no automatic outlier removal.
Constraint-hierarchy claims require at least five holdouts across three sectors and remain exploratory until independent replication.
design_invariants: GIZA NEXUS is the primary product identity; solver/phase codenames are secondary capabilities.
Preserve the dark industrial blue/amber GIZA workstation visual language.
Keep the five primary navigation modes: DISCOVER, EXPLORE, REVERSE ENGINEER, ANALYZE, SIMULATE.
Keep the Object Inspector as a docked right column; never overlay the 3-D scene.
Keep the central 3-D viewport visually dominant and Quick Views below it.
FINDINGS and solver content scroll inside the fixed inspector; they may not reflow the shell.
Human-readable interpretation appears before equations/technical detail.
Warnings and truth guards must be visually distinct from conclusions.
A feature release is not a design release. Shell changes require explicit human approval and a design-version update.
Never present a manually recreated mockup as a runtime screenshot.
RITUAL MAP lives inside the central viewport surface and may not alter the five primary navigation modes or right inspector dock.
The atlas must remain internally scrollable with a sticky map index; map content may be cinematic but epistemic labels must remain legible.
ACTION GRAPH is an eighth internal atlas view inside the existing central viewport; it is not a new global navigation mode.
Place nodes use cyan data styling, action nodes use amber interpretive styling, and evidence-strength rings remain secondary to textual epistemic labels.
ROOM GRAPH is a ninth internal atlas view; it does not create a new primary navigation mode.
ROOM GRAPH node coordinates are schematic and may not be rendered as measured wall positions.
PRIMARY PLAN PARSER custody state must remain visible whenever plan evidence is shown.
VISIBILITY LAB is the tenth internal MAP ATLAS view and may not alter the five primary global navigation modes or inspector dock.
VISIBILITY LAB may use depth/chokepoint styling, but must keep PREMETRIC / geometry-authority labels visible.
METRIC READINESS is the eleventh internal MAP ATLAS view; it may not alter the locked NEXUS shell.
Readiness progress bars represent workflow completion, not confidence or probability.
Zero registered plans and zero metric rays must remain visually explicit until the gates actually pass.

release_contract.build_note: Production browser verification and runtime screenshot capture require dependencies installed locally. If unavailable, record that limitation and do not fabricate a replacement runtime freeze.
